trajectory_summary: This call opens neutral, dips into friction when the rep muddles the credit-score qualifier with the tax credit and a knowledgeable customer calls it out three times, and ends with no bill amount, no bill document, and a vague 'I'll call you back once the design is done' close with no date, time, or handshake. The rep pushed through structural verify items but never resolved the customer's direct challenge or converted the call into a concrete booked appointment.
outcome_dispute: This should not be read as a booked or tentative appointment — the rep promises a future callback once a design is built, with no day/time given and no commitment mechanism, which is a callback outcome at best and reflects an unanchored close.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: Credit qualifier / tax credit conflation under customer challenge
primary_coaching_focus.quote: Is that for me to qualify with you guys or to qualify with the tax and incentives? Just for the because I am familiar with that.
primary_coaching_focus.why: A knowledgeable customer directly and repeatedly called out an inaccurate framing of the credit qualifier, and the rep never resolved it cleanly — this is the single moment that most damaged trust and is a repeatable, coachable error (separate Ion's internal requirement from the federal credit clearly, every time).

key_moments.quote: you guys would just need to have a form of taxable income and a credit score of six fifty or higher. Is that the case for you guys?
key_moments.stewart_read: The rep bundles Ion's internal 650 credit threshold with the federal tax incentive requirement, which is factually incorrect framing and immediately draws a knowledgeable customer's suspicion.

key_moments.quote: So be straight with me because I do understand what the system and how it works.
key_moments.stewart_read: This is effectively a trust/scam-adjacent challenge dressed as a factual correction. The rep had an opening to validate the customer's knowledge and pivot cleanly to Ion's specific offer, but instead got defensive and rushed past it.
